scope: First scenario startup and advice only; campaign remains unadmitted

campaignScenario.description: Xsi had the order to spy the humans for the Necromancer. But she wasn´t lucky. The humans realised her plans, hunted and prisonded her in a small valley. Now it`s on you to bring Xsi back home to the Necromancer. All maps are planed to play "expert". If you want choose your difficulty!
campaignScenario.name: Evil Way Home
campaignScenario.scenarioDescription: You have to reach the necromancers town with the Pendant of Life. Heroes experience is limited to level 8. Xsi and Isra would go to the next Map and take there Spells, Experience, Primary and secondary Skills with them.
